How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these walking shoes comfortable and easy to slip on and off without hands, with great arch support and a perfect fit, particularly for wide feet. They appreciate the shoes' appearance and consider them a good value for the price. The durability receives mixed feedback - while some say they hold up well to daily wear, others report that the soles and insoles wear out within four months.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
They Do Slip In Just Like Advertised On TV!
Sketchers Men's Hands Free Slip-ins I was skeptical about three slip in products at first, but they really do work exactly as advertised. The built-in heel design acts like a shoe horn, making it easy to slide my foot in without using my hands. They also slip off just as easily, which is a nice bonus. They’re very comfortable, just like other Skechers I’ve owned, and they look great too. They have good heel support and theyre super lightweight. The material is quality as you can expect from Sketchers shoes. They are versatile and the color worked out to where I like them (I bought them on a sale price for only a select few colors) so I'm happy about that. The sizing was spot on for me, so I’d say they fit true to size. Overall, these are practical, comfortable, and convenient shoes that live up to the hype. I'd recommend these to anyone who wants to give the slip in style shoes a shot- and/or who wants a good quality material shoe.

    These shoes are wonderful. Because of a recent surgery on my leg, I had a swollen foot and knee that made it nearly impossible to get any shoes on. I was told by a friend to give this brand a try, and I am so glad I did. I now have no more problems putting on my shoes. I do not have to lean down at all they just slip on and off in seconds as advertised. I purchased the Skechers men's go walk flex and highly recommend these for anyone that is having difficulty putting on or taking off their shoes for any reason. Do yourself a favor and get a pair, you will not regret it. I will buy another pair when the time comes.

About this Item

  • Skechers Hands Free Slip-Ins for an easy fit
  • Lightweight, responsive ULTRA GO cushioning
  • Skechers Air-Cooled Memory Foam cushioned comfort insole
  • Breathable mesh upper with elastic bungee laces, functions as a slip on
  • Machine washable, air dry

Product Description

Just step and go in flexible comfort and style wearing Skechers Hands Free Slip-ins: GO WALK Flex - Hands Up. Designed with our Heel Pillow, this stretch laced style features a mesh upper with synthetic hot melt details, Skechers Air-Cooled Memory Foam insole and a lightweight ULTRA GO cushioned midsole.
